citations.claim: At step 203 E approach is red (NS yellow phase), so EW has been red.
At step 204 E approach is green under active emergency with 0s all-red clearance, the first all_red_clearance violation.

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=204 on approach E; all other fields identical, same 340 steps. This removes the preemption and the failure disappears.

explanation: NS was green at step 202 and yellow at step 203. When the E-direction emergency became active at t=204, the controller switched immediately to EW green at step 204 with 0s of all-red (need 3s) and only ~1s of yellow (need 5s). Emergency preemption forces its direction green immediately instead of transitioning through the required yellow and all-red clearance intervals.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 3 s)

vision_note: The north-south signals are green in steps 201-202 and turn yellow in step 203. In step 204 the cross direction is already green, with no all-red gap between the yellow and the conflicting green.
